text:
marina: Heads-up — we need a quick onboarding bench for kelpie-10b (FP16 + q4 path). Can someone run a smoke + 1k-prompt latency/cost sweep? Need results by EOD for product sync. Targets: p95 < 180ms for 8-token gens, throughput baseline ~120 req/s on 8x A10s.
ryan: I can run this. Which promptset should I use and do we want KV-cache on? @marina
marina: Use onboard/promptsets/latency_short.json (telemetry subset). Include streaming vs non-streaming, and token economics (input+output). KV-cache yes for the baseline run.
sasha: also include sampling with --max_new_tokens=8 and an 8-token micro-bench path. Add --samples 1000.
ryan: kicked off smoke on canary cluster. Allocating 2 A10s per replica, batch=16, async batching enabled. Command: `./bench --model kelpie-10b --prompts latency_short.json --samples 1000 --quant 4 --kv-cache=true --stream=false --batch-size=16`
ci-bot: bench job queued -> https://ci.re.redwood/jobs/kelpie-10b-smoke-3345678901 (logs streaming) :rocket:
alex: saw a small jitter at ~sample 640 in the live logs, message: "evicting KV cache after 2.1s" — tagging infra to check host-level GC/oom_killer.
toshi: rollout thought: canary 5% with variant kelpie-10b-q4, fallback to kelpie-10b-q8. Set max_latency=300ms and automatic fallback on exceed.
ryan: smoke finished. Quick summary: p50 85ms, p95 190ms, p99 360ms. Throughput ~110 req/s steady on our 8xA10 baseline. Cost est: $0.0062/req (avg tokens 42). Uploading CSV + raw logs now.
marina: thanks. Please paste the exact command and attach the CSV link here.
ryan: attached results CSV + logs -> https://artifacts.re.redwood/kelpie10b/bench/3345678901/results.zip. Command used above; logs show occasional KV eviction spikes around sample 600-680.
sasha: action items: 1) infra check for GC/evictions (assign alex), 2) try prewarmed KV cache to reduce p99, 3) run quant-8 variant on same sweep and compare token economics.
alex: taking infra GC/eviction check. Will run host perf-flame and heap snapshots. Any preferred tracing config?
marina: flame + kernel hotspots and a heap profile would be ideal. Also capture nvprof for the sample window where eviction happened.
ci-bot: artifacts uploaded -> https://artifacts.re.redwood/kelpie10b/bench/3345678901/results.zip :white_check_mark:
toshi: noted. I'll prepare canary rollout config and set the console canary for Monday window.
ryan: starting q8 (quant-8) sweep now with same promptset and cluster. Will post numbers when done.
ryan: q8 sweep done: p50 72ms, p95 160ms, p99 250ms. Throughput 130 req/s. Cost est: $0.0051/req. Looks like q8 is a net win for cost+latency tradeoff vs q4 here.
marina: excellent. Remove q4 from immediate canary? or keep both and route small % to q4 for edge-case fidelity checks?
toshi: keep both for canary (q8 default, q4 fallback) and enable periodic fidelity evals. I'll add the config to the rollout.
sasha: adding follow-ups to onboarding checklist: schedule a 1-hr postmortem bench review, add promptset to stable eval harness, and create a perf regression ticket for p99 > 300ms.
marina: great work — logging notes for product sync. If anything else pops up ping thread. :thumbsup:
